n77aef5ed14.headline: Deloitte announces record global revenue of $36.8bn
n77aef5ed14.summary: Deloitte reported aggregate network revenue of $36.8 billion for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2016, representing 9.5% growth in local currency terms.
n77aef5ed14.why: Deloitte is one of the world's largest professional services firms, and its revenue growth reflects trends in consulting, audit, and advisory services globally.

ndccc8972f5.headline: CNB continues interventions against stronger koruna, spent over eight billion in July | Aktuálně.cz
ndccc8972f5.summary: The Czech National Bank intervened in the foreign exchange market, spending 8.29 billion korunas to purchase euros and weaken the koruna in July.
ndccc8972f5.why: Central bank FX interventions affect currency valuation, export competitiveness, and inflation dynamics in the Czech Republic.

n86c8ca8b9d.headline: From An Industrial Economy To A Paper Economy – The Stunning Decline Of Manufacturing In America, by Michael Snyder
n86c8ca8b9d.summary: An analysis outlines the significant decline of American manufacturing, noting the shift from industrial production to a service and paper economy.
n86c8ca8b9d.why: Manufacturing is a key driver of economic growth and employment in the U.S. Its decline affects trade balances, labor markets, and industrial competitiveness.

n5801065af1.headline: You can withdraw contactlessly from ATMs. The first bank in the Czech Republic launches the novelty | Aktuálně.cz
n5801065af1.summary: Air Bank and ČSOB in the Czech Republic introduced a new feature allowing contactless ATM withdrawals using contactless stickers, expanding Air Bank's ATM network significantly this year.
n5801065af1.why: Innovations in banking services improve customer convenience and can increase competition in the Czech banking sector.

n8b7acbf558.headline: We want to increase wages by at least five percent, calls the union chief. Profits from the Czech Republic flow abroad | Aktuálně.cz
n8b7acbf558.summary: Josef Středula, chairman of the Czech-Moravian Confederation of Trade Unions, stated the Czech economy can afford wage increases of at least five percent despite profits flowing abroad.
n8b7acbf558.why: Wage growth affects consumer spending and inflation; profit outflows highlight challenges in retaining economic gains domestically.

nb107d9fdab.why: Continental is a major automotive supplier; its revenue and profit trends reflect industry and export market conditions.
